title: Costume Contest
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this Halloween-themed episode, office members participate in costume contests, engage in pranks, and navigate conflicts related to office hierarchy and personal relationships. The episode features humorous interactions, office disputes, and the announcement of a costume contest winner, with underlying tensions and character dynamics highlighted throughout.
